ground_metric: true shortest path in the full quotient (0..3), exact sparse LP
clipped_diagnostic: 0/1/2-clipped cost, kept only for the paired audit
singletons: counted in the census and kept as quotient nodes; excluded from the intra-group averages
gromov: halved convention (max pair-sum - second)/2; exact only on components <= 24 nodes, otherwise BLOCKED_NOT_FULL_CENSUS
